# Vardy Watch

> Track Premier League goal-scoring streaks against Jamie Vardy's 11-game record.

Last updated: 2026-10-23

Index updates do not establish source-data freshness. Early previews may use unverified source data; retain each article's warnings and conditional language.

## Pages

- [Vardy Watch](https://vardywatch.com/index.md): Dashboard overview and published data link.
- [Club scorers and streaks](https://vardywatch.com/clubs/index.md): Current-season leaderboard rules, active runs and full-season fixture views.
- [Weekly previews](https://vardywatch.com/blog/index.md): Latest published edition, or an empty state before publication.
- [Preview archive](https://vardywatch.com/blog/archive.md): All published editions.
- [Scoring-streak methodology](https://vardywatch.com/blog/methodology.md): Definitions and publication approach.
